text:
I understand your frustration! You can absolutely find your account without your email address. I can look you up using your first name, last name, and zip code instead.

Could you please provide:
- Your first name
- Your last name  
- Your zip code

This will allow me to locate your account so I can help you with the returns for the cleaner, headphones, and smartwatch.
zh:
我理解你的沮丧！你完全可以没有电子邮件地址找到你的账户。我可以用你的名字、姓氏和邮政编码来查找你。

你能提供：
- 你的名字
- 你的姓氏  
- 你的邮政编码

这将允许我找到你的账户，这样我就能帮你处理清洁器、耳机和智能手表的退货。
